comments.body:
Sure, the city is expensive, but there are tons of activities provided at eth. There is the ASVZ if you wanna do solo or group sports, then there is the VSETH with tons of Student Associations and Comittees that all regularly make events, there are even two weekly bars by students, LochNess on Höngg and PapperlaPub in Zentrum.

For just going to get a coffee, ETH is probably way worse than Italy, but if you actually look at all the available activites and make use of everything VSETH provides, you will find tons of fun activities and people to enjoy them with.
comments.author: Aster1xch
